questions.subtype: 빈칸 단어 영영풀이 아닌 것 — 다의어
questions.question:
각 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 단어의 영영풀이가 아닌 것은? (순서 상관없음)
• Mr. Kim ________s the hotel for his uncle.
• The jumper tried to ________ the bar without touching it.
• Who ________s this car? Is it yours?
• What does this sign ________?
choices: ① to have a particular meaning or result
② to have something that belongs to you
③ to go over something without touching it
④ to remove things from a place
⑤ to control or manage a business or organization
questions.explanation: 빈칸 = run(운영하다) · clear(넘다) · own(소유하다) · mean(의미하다). ④는 clear의 다른 뜻(치우다) 풀이라 어느 빈칸에도 맞지 않음.  [출처: YBM(박준언) L7·YBM(박준언) L8 다의어(풀이: 단어DB)]

review.원문변형: 빈칸 문장 창작(11-27 오류검증: run/own이 서로 바뀌어 들어가거나 clear a farm으로 읽히는 문장 교체 → 빈칸마다 단어 하나)
review.정답근거: 빈칸 = run(운영하다) · clear(넘다) · own(소유하다) · mean(의미하다). ④는 clear의 다른 뜻(치우다) 풀이라 어느 빈칸에도 맞지 않음.
review.오답설계: ①②③⑤ = 단어DB 풀이. 1번 run(own 불가: 삼촌 대신 운영) · 3번 own(run 불가) — 빈칸·풀이 일대일

student.왜: 빈칸 = run(운영하다) · clear(넘다) · own(소유하다) · mean(의미하다). ④는 clear의 다른 뜻(치우다) 풀이라 어느 빈칸에도 맞지 않음.
student.오답: run 달리다 · clear 치우다 · own 자신의 · mean 못된 — 다른 뜻을 떠올리면 헷갈림

questions.passage:
People pay different kinds of taxes. Here are the main ones.
• Income tax: People who earn money from their jobs pay income tax.
• Sales tax: All people pay sales tax on the things that they buy. For example, when you buy bread, you pay sales tax.
• Property tax: People who own houses or land have to pay property tax.
Taxes do a lot of good things for us! Thanks to taxes, we get free education at middle school. Taxes are used for our environment. They pay for the clean air and water which we need. Taxes also pay for our safety, like streetlights by roads. So, you can ask the country to put more streetlights in dark places.
Taxes are all around us. They pay for things that we use every day. They can make our lives better. <u>세금이 낭비되면, 우리는 우리가 필요한 서비스를 받을 수 없다.</u> So, taxes must be used wisely. We need to see that taxes are used the right way.
